name: bld_involution_rank_add_rank
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (h : A * A = 1) : Matrix.rank (1 + A) + Matrix.rank (1 - A) = Fintype.card ι
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (h : A * A = 1), Matrix.rank (1 + A) + Matrix.rank (1 - A) = Fintype.card ι
informal: Uses Mathlib2.gen_lin_idempotent_rank_complement_field: P = (1/2) • (1 + A) is idempotent with 1 - P = (1/2) • (1 - A); rank is invariant under scaling by the unit 1/2.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Fintype ι] [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K), A * A = 1 → (1 + A).rank + (1 - A).rank = Fintype.card ι
